headline: DeltaSelect paper reports a budgeted task subset for repeat coding-agent A/B tests
summary: A paper introduces DeltaSelect, which ranks tasks using resampled one-run correlations with full-benchmark scores, calibrates fractional verifier results, then selects tasks under a cost budget for repeated baseline-versus-candidate comparisons. In one author-reported Agent Layer case study, 13 eight-task evaluations led to a configuration with a 58.1% lower recorded cost and a higher calibrated score than the initial custom skills/instructions. The paper also finds substantial mismatch between published DeepSWE estimates and a Codex target harness. These are bounded paper-reported results; the implementation was not run in this review.
